patch_description: Keep the hex seed layout and the radii solver, but wrap them in a perturb-and-resolve loop: after computing radii, measure each circle's "slack" (how much room it has to its nearest neighbor/wall constraints). Circles that are tightly constrained (little slack) are the bottleneck for the LP-like sum; iteratively push centers of tight circles away from their tightest neighbor/wall by a small step proportional to the tightness, then re-solve radii. Track the best (highest-sum) feasible configuration across iterations. This directly targets the center-placement headroom identified in prior feedback, while reusing the proven radius solver. Also add a small jitter-restart across a few relaxation rounds so the search does not depend on a single trajectory.
